points.decision: 审查尼克博克信托账目后认定其已资不抵债，未出手阻止挤兑。
points.evidence: Morgan and his associates examined the books of the Knickerbocker Trust and decided it was insolvent, so they did not intervene to stop the run.

points.decision: 周四上午向纽约多家银行存入约2500万美元。
points.evidence: On Thursday morning Cortelyou deposited around $25 million into a number of New York banks.

points.decision: 为避免纽约市破产发出灾难性信号，签约购买3000万美元市政债券。
points.evidence: In an effort to avoid the disastrous signal that a New York City bankruptcy would send, Morgan contracted to purchase $30 million worth of city bonds.

points.decision: 1908年5月通过《奥尔德里奇-弗里兰法》，设立国家货币委员会调查恐慌并提出银行监管立法。
points.evidence: In May 1908, Congress passed the Aldrich–Vreeland Act, which established the National Monetary Commission to investigate the panic and to propose legislation to regulate banking.
